unreleased: Add an articles module (src/modules/articles): a list with search and a type filter, the article page drawn in its type's colours (light and dark theme), and an administrator area to write articles with the full editor (images, video, tables, HTML source), choose status and display window, pin them and manage the article types and their colours
The rich-text editor gains text alignment, tables, a horizontal rule, code blocks, YouTube / Vimeo video links and an HTML source mode (the server still strips anything unsafe on save)

A module can declare the modules it requires (a console warning is logged once when one is enabled without them) and contribute components to named slots that other modules render with <ModuleSlot>, so a module can extend another module's pages without that module knowing about it

The release build no longer writes its own frontend .env with fixed addresses: it copies the development directory's frontend/.env as it is stored, stops with guidance when it is missing, and warns when an address in it points at localhost

Add a Portfolio module (src/modules/portfolio): a responsive grid of project cards, a page for each project with its description, technologies and an Open button, and an administrator area at /portfolio/manage to add, edit, reorder, hide and delete projects in Czech and English - the header link is left to the site that uses it

The build now writes robots.txt and a sitemap.xml of the public pages from VITE_APP_URL (left out, with a warning, when it is not set), adds a share image to index.html, and index.html carries a description and Open Graph tags for crawlers and link previews that do not run JavaScript

Add the public pages of the freelancer site: a new home page, Services, Pricing and financing (with sample prices, marked as such on the page), About me, and the Privacy, Terms and Cookies pages written for this site, all in Czech and English; the home page also describes the site for search engines (schema.org)
Add a Contact page to this site: a heading and introduction, the email, address, GitHub and LinkedIn details next to the form, and a note, in Czech and English

Page titles and descriptions no longer say "Authenticate WFB": every page now takes the application's name (nav.brand) and a default description (meta.description) from its translations, and also sets a canonical URL, Open Graph and Twitter tags and the page language. Sign-in, account, administration and diagnostic pages ask search engines not to index them

The contact page can now show an introduction, contact details (email, address, GitHub, LinkedIn) and a note next to the form, all set per deployment; the page moved to /contact (/kontakt redirects there). With nothing configured it is still just the form
Switch on the CRM module for this site: administrators get a header link to their partners, the partners' tasks and the invoices uploaded against them

Add a CRM module (src/modules/crm), shown to administrators only: a header icon opens the partner list with search, each partner's page with their tasks, and each task's page where invoice PDFs are uploaded, downloaded and deleted - in Czech and English
